creator: millee.md
title: Securitymaxxing pt.3: three more vibe-coded app holes with the Claude Code prompt for each -- XSS (escape/sanitize user content), unchecked file uploads (check type/size, store non-executable), and unverified Stripe webhooks (verify signature)

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: Terminal 'Welcome to Claude Code! cwd: ~/my-app' with the three fix prompts typed in

tools.name: Stripe webhooks
tools.detail: Verify webhook signature so only real Stripe events are accepted

claims: XSS: a comment or username containing script can run in every other user's browser and steal logins
Unchecked uploads: an uploaded file can execute on the server and take it over
Fake payment webhooks: without signature verification anyone can send 'payment_succeeded' and get the product free
how_to_steps: Prompt 1: 'escape and sanitize anything a user submits before it ever gets shown on the page'
Prompt 2: 'check the file type and size on every upload and store files somewhere they can never be executed'
Prompt 3: 'verify the webhook signature so only real events from Stripe get through'
on_screen_only: Mock app.com/comments showing comment 'nice app! <script>steal(logins)</script>' replicated across posts
Mock uploads.app.com: 'invoice.pdf.sh' executing, 'spawning shell... reading secrets...' with srv-01/02/03 online

Mock api.app.com/webhooks incoming events: 'payment_succeeded $29.00 from: stripe.com signature verified' vs 'payment_succeeded $29.00 from: totally-stripe.biz NO SIGNATURE' accepted with a green check, 'your app: looks good to me'
Claude Code suggestion placeholder: 'try "audit my auth flow"'
cta: Follow me for more AI content

relevance.why: All three apply to Haji's paid apps; the Stripe webhook signature check in particular is a revenue leak if missed.

implement_score.why: Three one-line prompts to run in Claude Code per app, plus add to the prelaunch checklist. Minutes each; Stripe signature check should be verified with 'stripe listen' test events.

verify: Confirm each app verifies Stripe-Signature with the endpoint secret and rejects replayed events (idempotency)
Upload storage: use object storage (S3/Supabase Storage) with content-type checks rather than the app server

gap.what: Liked set covers login/auth holes and RLS; webhook signature verification and non-executable upload storage are new specifics (XSS was already in the top-5 holes video).
